newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai banks cut buy/sell spreads for baht/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Thai banks cut buy/sell spreads for baht/dlr.

text.p: Thai commercial banks sharply cut buy/sell spreads of their quoted baht/dollar rates on Friday as they further adjusted to the Bank of Thailand's decision to float the baht on Wednesday.

An official of Thai Farmers Bank Plc said his bank reduced the buy/sell spread of its telex transfer (TT) baht/dollar rate to 20 satangs shortly before noon Friday against 50 satangs on Thursday and 150 satangs on Wednesday.
Thai Farmers quoted its TT rate at 28.60/28.80 baht to the dollar against 28.15/28.65 by Bangkok Bank Plc and 28.20/28.90 by the Siam Commercial Bank Plc.
A treasury official at Bangkok Bank said his bank would adjust its quote in early afternoon.

Thailand announced on Wednesday that it was proceeding with a managed float of the baht, which came under attack from speculators in May. The currency lost about 15 to 20 percent of its value following the news.
